summary: C06 is implemented and unit-tested: resolve_font rebuilds every fallback candidate with the requested weight, style, and OpenType features via fallback_with_requested_traits, and vendor/gpui-pre/src/text_system.rs compiles clean. The assigned verification command cargo test -p gpui-pre cannot run in this repository because the vendored test target includes assets/fonts files that C01 never vendored, so completion is blocked on an owner decision about that gap.

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: vendor/gpui-pre/src/text_system.rs:374-378 rebuilds each fallback candidate with fallback_with_requested_traits (text_system.rs:1343-1358), which keeps the fallback's family and fallbacks but takes the requested Font's weight, style, and OpenType features. The added test text_system::fallback_tests::fallback_replaces_only_the_unavailable_family (text_system.rs:1525-1543) asserts the family is replaced while BOLD weight, Italic style, and non-default OpenType features are preserved, and it passes (scratch run above). cargo check -p gpui-pre and cargo check --workspace both exit 0. The task-doc visual acceptance (bold Han fallback at bold weight against 09-language-zh.png) belongs to the Batch D fixtures and is not exercised here; the blocker records why the assigned cargo test -p gpui-pre cannot run in-repo.

risks: The missing assets/fonts files are not specific to C06: vendor/gpui-pre/src/svg_renderer.rs:361-363 and vendor/gpui-pre/examples/example_support/fonts.rs:10,26 include_bytes! them, so every cargo test -p gpui-pre (and example build) fails at compile time until the fonts are vendored or those targets are gated; Batch D visual-parity fixtures will likely need real font assets too.

Fallback text now resolves through the platform's closest face for the requested weight/style instead of the fallback family's regular face, matching the fork's P-D behavior; the change is unit-tested but not visually verified in this batch, so fallback text metrics may differ from the previous regular-face resolution.
blockers: The assigned verification command cargo test -p gpui-pre cannot run in this repository: the vendored lib test target and examples include assets/fonts/ibm-plex-sans/IBMPlexSans-Regular.ttf and assets/fonts/lilex/Lilex-Regular.ttf (vendor/gpui-pre/src/svg_renderer.rs:361-363, vendor/gpui-pre/examples/example_support/fonts.rs:10,26), and no assets/ directory or font file has ever been tracked in this repository. Owner decision needed: vendor the real font assets, gate the asset-dependent test module and examples, or amend the verification recipe for vendored-crate patches as T05 did (cargo check plus the bridge crate's tests). The C06 unit test passes as soon as the test target builds, as the scratch run above shows.
